api_version.label: API
api_version.help: v1 (apirest.php, GLPI 9.5-11) or v2 (api.php high-level API, GLPI 11+).

app_token.label: App-Token (v1)
app_token.help: Optional; required when the API client defines one.

entities_id.label: Entity ID
entities_id.help: 0 creates tickets in the API user's active entity.

close_on_resolve.label: Close after solving
close_on_resolve.help: Moves the ticket from Solved to Closed immediately.

webhook_signing_secret.label: GLPI webhook secret
webhook_signing_secret.help: The secret shown in GLPI's webhook form; overrides the channel's generated secret.

severity_map.label: Severity mapping (JSON)
severity_map.help: Optional override of urgency, impact and priority per McHarbor severity.

form.title: GLPI tickets
form.intro: McHarbor opens a GLPI incident ticket, adds a private follow-up on repeats and adds a solution when the alert recovers.
form.name: Channel name
form.instanceUrlHelp: Base URL of GLPI, without /apirest.php or /api.php. Only https:// is accepted.
form.apiV2: High-level API v2 (api.php, GLPI 11 and later)
form.appTokenHelp: Optional. Required when the GLPI API client defines an App-Token.
form.userTokenHelp: The API token (remote access key) from the API user's preferences.
form.v2PathHelp: The version segment after /api.php/, for example v2.0.
form.entityHelp: 0 creates tickets in the API user's active entity.
form.groupHelp: API v1 only. 0 leaves the ticket unassigned.
form.pollHelp: How often McHarbor reads the status of open tickets. 0 means webhook only.
form.reopenHelp: Reopen a ticket solved within this many minutes instead of opening a new one. 0 always opens a new ticket.
form.closeOnResolve: Close the ticket after adding the solution
form.updateOnRepeat: Add a follow-up when the alert fires again
form.webhookHelp: GLPI 11 only. Paste the secret from GLPI's webhook form, or paste this channel's secret into GLPI instead.
form.severityMapHelp: Optional. Overrides urgency, impact and priority for critical, warning or info.
form.secretKeep: Leave blank to keep the stored value.
form.outOfRange: Must be a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}

guide.title: Connect GLPI
guide.step1: In GLPI, go to Setup, General, API. Enable the REST API and, for API v1, enable login with an external token.
guide.step2: API v1: add an API client whose IPv4 range includes McHarbor's address. Copy its App-Token if one is generated.
guide.step3: Create a dedicated user with a profile that can create, update and solve tickets and add follow-ups in the target entity. In that user's preferences, generate the API token (remote access key).
guide.step4: API v2 on GLPI 11: in Setup, OAuth clients, create a client with the password grant and the api scope, and note its ID and secret.
guide.step5: Enter the entity, the ITIL category and the group IDs, then click Test connection. McHarbor checks the entity and creates nothing.
guide.step6: GLPI 11 status updates: in Setup, Notifications, Webhooks, add a webhook for itemtype Ticket on the update event, pointing at this channel's inbound URL, with the HTTP method POST. Leave the challenge-response (CRA) option off.
guide.step7: Copy the webhook's secret into the GLPI webhook secret field here, or type this channel's secret into GLPI. Optionally filter the webhook to tickets whose external ID starts with mcharbor:.
guide.step8: GLPI 9.5 and 10 have no webhooks. McHarbor polls open tickets at the poll interval.
